correctness.rationale: The source gives \(u=U\circ\omega\) with \(\omega(0)=0\). For \(q=q_r(f)\), \(\psi(z)=\omega(rz)/(qr)\) is a disk self-map, so Littlewood subordination gives \(\|P_rf\|_p^p\le M_p(qr)\). For \(p>1\), \(|U|^p\) has positive Riesz mass in every annulus because \(\Phi'\) never vanishes, hence \(M_p\) is strictly increasing. If \(q=1\), maximum-modulus rigidity forces \(\omega(z)=e^{i\theta_0}z\), and boundary uniqueness gives exactly the rotated \(\operatorname{sgn}\cos\) traces.
